name: Sangharsh Samajik Sanstha
tagline: Struggle with the community, not for the community
summary: Sangharsh Samajik Sanstha is a registered social organisation working with communities that are often left out of public services. We run our programmes through local volunteers and paid field workers who live in the areas they serve.
Our work begins with listening. Each village or ward decides its own priorities, and we bring the people, funding and know-how to act on them.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To work with communities so that every child can learn, every family can reach healthcare and every adult can earn a fair living with dignity.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: A society where nobody's birthplace, gender or income decides how far they can go, and where communities lead their own progress.

values.title: Compassion
values.text: We start from respect for every person we meet.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We say what we do, do what we say and publish the results.

values.title: Participation
values.text: People affected by a problem help design the answer.

values.title: Sustainability
values.text: We build skills and systems that outlast any single project.

initiatives.title: Shiksha Saathi
initiatives.description: Free evening learning centres and scholarships for children who would otherwise drop out.

initiatives.title: Swasthya Shivir
initiatives.description: Monthly health camps with doctors, medicines and follow-up care in remote areas.

initiatives.title: Shakti Groups
initiatives.description: Savings and enterprise groups that give women their own income and a collective voice.

initiatives.title: Swachh Gaon
initiatives.description: Community-run water points, toilets and tree planting drives.

initiatives.title: Kaushal Kendra
initiatives.description: Short courses in trades and digital skills linked to local job openings.

initiatives.title: Adhikar Desk
initiatives.description: Free help claiming pensions, documents and welfare entitlements.
